name: ScanMintQR Commerce
author: aarranvince

sections.description:
ScanMintQR Commerce connects your WooCommerce store with the ScanMintQR platform.

The plugin allows WooCommerce store owners to:

  • Generate QR codes for WooCommerce products.
  • Generate Code 128 product barcode labels.
  • Generate or manage product SKUs.
  • Work with product variations.
  • Connect WooCommerce products to a ScanMintQR account.

Some functionality communicates with the external ScanMintQR service at scanmintqr.com.

A ScanMintQR account may be required for functionality that uses the ScanMintQR service.

External Services

ScanMintQR Commerce connects to the ScanMintQR service at https://scanmintqr.com in order to generate and manage QR codes, product barcodes and related commerce assets.

When a store administrator uses a ScanMintQR generation feature, the plugin may send the following WooCommerce product information to ScanMintQR:

  • WooCommerce product or variation ID
  • Product or variation name
  • Product SKU
  • Product URL
  • Resource type (product or variant)

The plugin also sends the store’s ScanMintQR Commerce API key in the request header to authenticate the request.

This data is sent only when a ScanMintQR feature requiring the external service is used.

ScanMintQR service:
https://scanmintqr.com/

Terms of Service:
https://scanmintqr.com/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://scanmintqr.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ScanMintQR Commerce plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the ScanMintQR settings page in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Connect your ScanMintQR account.
  5. Open a WooCommerce product to access the ScanMintQR tools.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. ScanMintQR Commerce is designed to work with WooCommerce.

Do I need a ScanMintQR account?

A ScanMintQR account is required for features that communicate with the ScanMintQR service.

Where is ScanMintQR available?

Visit https://scanmintqr.com/ for more information.
